title: Explain browser API failures
responsibility: Map known API failure codes to readable wording without exposing unknown server messages.

inputs.name: browserError.code
inputs.description: Server error code to look up.

inputs.name: browserError.status
inputs.description: HTTP status, or zero for an unreachable server.

outputs.name: browserError
outputs.description: Known code wording; otherwise a generic failure containing a nonzero status, or server-unreachable wording for zero.
